api:
<Barcode data={requests} value={|r: &Request| r.latency} group={|r: &Request| r.region} />
PropTypeDefault
dataVec<T>, Signal<Vec<T>>, or your own Datasetrequired
valueFn(&T) -> f64required
groupFn(&T) -> &str: one row of ticks per groupone row
tick_widthf32, pixels1.5
colorone colour for every groupa series colour per group
x_axisAxisConfigAxisConfig::new()
tooltip, classas on <Trend>

A thin tick per value. Dense areas look darker.

examples.title: One distribution
examples.code:
#[component]
fn single() {
    let data = use_signal(measures(&[("", 50., 12.)], 120));
    rsx! { <Barcode data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} class="h-24" /> }
}

examples.title: Per plant
examples.description: One row of ticks per group.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn groups() {
    let data = use_signal(measures(
        &[
            ("Plant A", 40., 6.),
            ("Plant B", 52., 10.),
            ("Plant C", 47., 3.),
        ],
        80,
    ));
    rsx! { <Barcode data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} group={|m: &Measure| m.group} class="h-56" /> }
}

examples.title: Thicker ticks
examples.code:
#[component]
fn thick() {
    let data = use_signal(measures(&[("Before", 12., 2.), ("After", 9., 1.5)], 60));
    rsx! { <Barcode data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} group={|m: &Measure| m.group} tick_width={3.} color={rgb(0x8839ef)} class="h-40" /> }
}

examples.title: Hairline ticks
examples.description: Two hundred values per group drawn with 1px ticks.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn weekdays() {
    let data = use_signal(measures(
        &[("Weekday", 35., 8.), ("Weekend", 50., 15.)],
        200,
    ));
    rsx! { <Barcode data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} group={|m: &Measure| m.group} tick_width={1.} class="h-40" /> }
}

examples.title: Labelled axis
examples.description: Request latencies in orange with an axis label.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn latency() {
    let data = use_signal(measures(&[("", 180., 40.)], 300));
    rsx! { <Barcode data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} color={rgb(0xfe640b)} x_axis={AxisConfig::new().label("Latency (ms)")} class="h-28" /> }
}

examples.title: Five regions
examples.description: Five rows of ticks, one per sales region.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn regions() {
    let data = use_signal(measures(
        &[
            ("North", 62., 9.),
            ("South", 71., 6.),
            ("East", 55., 12.),
            ("West", 68., 8.),
            ("Central", 60., 4.),
        ],
        50,
    ));
    rsx! { <Barcode data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} group={|m: &Measure| m.group} class="h-64" /> }
}

examples.title: No tooltip
examples.description: Day and night readings with the tooltip hidden.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn quiet() {
    let data = use_signal(measures(&[("Day", 22., 3.), ("Night", 17., 4.)], 90));
    rsx! { <Barcode data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} group={|m: &Measure| m.group} tooltip={Tooltip::hidden()} class="h-40" /> }
}

examples.title: Few values

    rsx! { <Barcode data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} tick_width={6.} color={rgb(0xdf8e1d)} class="h-24" /> }
}

examples.title: Exam scores
examples.description: Four subjects compared on one labelled axis.
examples.code:

        &[
            ("Maths", 64., 14.),
            ("Physics", 58., 12.),
            ("Art", 75., 9.),
            ("History", 69., 11.),
        ],
        70,
    ));
    rsx! { <Barcode data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} group={|m: &Measure| m.group} x_axis={AxisConfig::new().label("Score")} class="h-56" /> }

examples.title: Six hundred values
examples.description: A dense standard-normal sample in green.
examples.code:

fn dense() {
    let data = use_signal(measures(&[("", 0., 1.)], 600));
    rsx! { <Barcode data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} tick_width={1.} color={rgb(0x40a02b)} class="h-32" /> }
}
